Saudi Arabia · GCC · Jordan

GCC & Jordan cross-border taxi from Saudi Arabia

A pre-booked private car with a professional driver, from your door in Saudi Arabia to Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, the UAE or Jordan — and back. One fixed fare in writing before you book.

Request a Cross-Border QuoteChoose your country
Quick Answer

Taxi Saudi Arabia arranges private cross-border transfers from Saudi Arabia to Bahrain (King Fahd Causeway), Qatar (Salwa–Abu Samra), Kuwait (Al Khafji–Nuwaiseeb), the UAE (Al Batha–Ghuwaifat) and Jordan (Halat Ammar–Al Mudawwara or Al Durrah, whichever is shorter). You get one car and driver door to door and a fixed fare in writing; each passenger carries their own valid documents and completes the border checks in person.

Countries
5 corridors
Shortest
Al Khobar–Manama ~50 km
Fare
Fixed, in writing
Hours
24/7

What we arrange

  • A private car and professional driver from our vetted partner network, door to door.
  • A vehicle confirmed as eligible for your specific crossing before we quote.
  • A pickup time planned with margin for the border, flights and meetings.
  • One-way, return or waiting — priced as one fixed fare with border crossing fees included, no meter, no surge.
  • 15–30 minutes of free waiting on every trip.
  • Written quotes for companies; corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.

What passengers handle

  • Valid passports or accepted ID, and the right to enter the destination country.
  • Saudi residents: a valid exit and re-entry visa where it applies.
  • Completing their own exit and entry checks at the border, in person.

We do not arrange visas, permits or immigration, and border processing time is never guaranteed.

What passengers need at the border

  • A valid passport (or the ID your nationality may use for this crossing) for every passenger, including children.
  • The right to enter the destination country — visa, eVisa or exemption, depending on nationality.
  • Saudi residents: a valid exit and re-entry visa where it applies.
  • Requirements change. Confirm current entry rules with official sources before you travel — we do not arrange visas or immigration.

How booking works

  1. 1

    Send your trip. Route, date, passengers, luggage and vehicle — by form, WhatsApp or email.

  2. 2

    Written fixed fare. We confirm a vehicle and driver eligible for your crossing and send one fixed fare, with border crossing fees included. No meter, no surge.

  3. 3

    Door-to-door pickup. Your driver collects you at the agreed address and time.

  4. 4

    Border checks. Each passenger completes their own exit and entry checks. Border time varies and is never guaranteed.

  5. 5

    Drop-off. Straight to your hotel, home, office or airport on the other side.

What decides a cross-border fare

Cross-border trips are quoted individually — there is no meter and no surge. You receive one fixed fare in writing before you book, with border crossing fees for the vehicle included. It is based on:

  • Exact pickup and drop-off addresses
  • Border crossing and total distance
  • Vehicle class — executive sedan, full-size SUV, van
  • Passengers and large bags
  • Date and time of travel
  • One-way, return or driver waiting (15–30 min free waiting included)

Cross-border transfer questions

Which countries can I travel to by car from Saudi Arabia with you?

We arrange private cross-border transfers between Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, the UAE and Jordan. Each corridor has its own page with the border crossing used and the bookable routes.

Do I need a visa for a cross-border trip from Saudi Arabia?

Each passenger needs a valid passport or accepted ID and the right to enter the destination country; Saudi residents generally also need a valid exit and re-entry visa. Requirements depend on nationality and change, so confirm with official sources before travel. We do not arrange visas or immigration.

What happens at the border?

Your driver stays with the car while every passenger completes their own exit and entry checks. Border processing time varies with traffic, immigration, customs and official procedures and is never guaranteed, so we plan extra time around flights and meetings.

Is the car allowed to cross the border?

Not every vehicle can cross every border. When you request a quote, the car and driver for your date are confirmed as eligible for that specific crossing before we send the fixed fare.

How long does the King Fahd Causeway trip to Bahrain take?

Al Khobar to Manama is about 50 km and Dammam to Manama about 70 km — roughly an hour of driving. Border time on the causeway is extra and varies.

Can the same car wait and bring me back?

Yes. Book a return and the driver can wait for a same-day return, or collect you on a later date. Waiting time is included in the written quote.

Can my company get a written quote and invoice?

Yes. Email a corporate RFQ with routes, dates, passengers and vehicles and we reply in writing. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.
